Katrina — thanks for the blackout windows, that's helpful. A couple of specifics from our side before the walkthrough:
- Canary plan: we'll do a 72-hour canary with 10% traffic diverted initially, automated rollback on error-rate > 1.5% or latency degradation > 40% vs baseline.
- Migration lanes: phase 1 (pilot): read-only traffic + shadow writes; phase 2: 50% production traffic with staged writes; phase 3: full cutover with canary rollback gates.
- Evaluation artifacts: we'll publish a runbook and an eval checklist that includes prompt set regressions and token-cost regressions.
